chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he would pass by the graves, would say:
Peace be upon you from the abode of a believing people, and indeed, if Allah wills, we shall join you.

key_terms.السَّلَامُ: peace; a greeting of peace and supplication
key_terms.الْقُبُورِ: the graves; the burial places of the deceased
key_terms.قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ: a believing people; the deceased described as believers
key_terms.لَاحِقُونَ: joining; those who will follow after in death

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say when passing by graves?
ai.summary: This hadith records what the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would say when passing by graves. It expresses greeting the deceased with peace, acknowledging their faith, and remembering the certainty that the living will also join them by the will of Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.534 - When the Messenger of Allah (sw) would pass by graves, he would say:

Al-salāmu ‘alaykum min diyāri qawmin mu’minīn, wa innā in shā’a Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn
'Peace be upon you, O’ dwellers of the homes of believers. Indeed, if Allah (swt) wills, we shall join you.'"
